title: Category pricing needs See Financial Data as well as Settings — Parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Settings — Parts' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products and Services field shows.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Press Esc.
  5. Open the three-dot menu beside New Category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page lists category A in the Category column.
  • It shows no pricing columns.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows its name, QuickBooks Products and Services and Tax Exempt.
  • It has no Pricing Matrix picker, grid or Edit.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Delete.
  • It has no Audit Log.

Step 4:

  • The menu closes.

Step 5:

  • The Categories list offers no Audit Log for this user.
  • New Category is still offered.
